request.amount_ada: 500,000,000 ada net change limit; no direct treasury withdrawal requested
request.deadline: Period begins at the start of Epoch 613 on February 13, 2026 and ends at the close of Epoch 713 on or about July 3, 2027.
deliverables: Record DReps' agreement to a 500,000,000 ada cap on total Treasury Withdrawals debited during Epochs 613-713
Supersede any prior Net Change Limit for the same period
Apply the cumulative-sum accounting method in lovelace, excluding Treasury inflows
request.what: Info action to agree a new Net Change Limit for Cardano Treasury withdrawals for Epochs 613-713.

claims.claim: The proposal sets a Net Change Limit of 500,000,000 ada, equal to 500,000,000,000,000 lovelace, for Cardano Treasury withdrawals during Epochs 613-713.
The proposed period begins at the start of Epoch 613 on February 13, 2026 and ends at the close of Epoch 713 on or about July 3, 2027.
The Net Change Limit caps only lovelace removed from the Treasury by enacted Treasury Withdrawals recorded on the Cardano ledger.
Treasury inflows, including reserve and protocol allocations, transaction-fee allocations, refunds, and returns of Treasury-funded amounts, do not count toward or increase the limit.
Treasury Withdrawals already debited during the Epochs 613-713 period count toward the 500,000,000 ada cumulative limit.
The proposal states that this Info action has no direct on-chain effect and does not authorize any Treasury Withdrawal.
The proposer asserts that the existing 350,000,000 ada Net Change Limit has been useful but is becoming practically constrained before mid-2027.
The proposal asserts that DReps retain full discretion to approve or reject each Treasury Withdrawal after agreeing this limit.
The proposal claims it is drafted to comply with the enacted Cardano Constitution version 2.4 and Appendix I Guardrails, and references an IPFS copy of that Constitution.
The proposal claims that nothing in the Constitution limits DReps to a single Net Change Limit or prevents a newly agreed limit from applying to the same period.

summary: The document proposes an Info action setting a 500,000,000 ada Treasury Net Change Limit for Epochs 613-713, clarifies ledger-based cumulative accounting, excludes inflows, counts prior withdrawals in the period, and states the action is non-spending and non-binding on individual withdrawal decisions.
